name: When do I need to consider structural framing changes during a home renovation?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to consider structural framing changes during a home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need to consider structural framing changes when altering load-bearing walls, adding new rooms or levels, or creating larger open-concept spaces by removing interior walls. These changes require careful engineering to ensure the home remains stable and safe. AKN Design Group’s integrated design-build process includes assessing structural requirements early in the planning, ensuring all necessary modifications are identified and engineered correctly before construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider structural framing changes when modifying load-bearing walls, adding rooms, or creating open-concept spaces. Proper engineering is crucial.
